text:
eli_r: Quick thread 1 — I opened a tiny docs PR that adds an example showing how quota tiers affect the "cost by route" panel and an SDK snippet to set the quota attribution header. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2789

maya_g: Nice. Can we make the snippet language-match SDKv5 and keep headers lowercase?

eli_r: yes, updated to SDKv5 example and lowercase header. snippet:

```js
client.request({
  route: '/v1/generate',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-quota-attr': 'team:alpha' },
  body: { model: 'open-7b', input: '...' }
})
```

sam_t: tiny nit: name the header `x-redwood-quota-tenant` in the doc example; that's the field our billing pipeline expects. also add a 1-line caution that only service tokens can set it.

eli_r: changed header name and added the caution.

devops-bot: lint check: markdown link style mismatch in PR, line 12.

docs-reviewer: I think we should avoid hard numbers for burst sizes in the public doc. Better to show a labeled graph snapshot and an annotated caption explaining expected shapes (short spike vs sustained increase).

maya_g: Agreed. I created a public grafana snapshot and added the link: https://grafana.public/redwood/snap/usage-tier-change-2026. Replaced internal-only link in the doc.

eli_r: added a short FAQ entry: "Will quotas change immediately after a tier update?" Answer: usually, but migrations and grace windows can apply — link to billing migration playbook.

sam_t: lgtm. please include instruction to capture x-request-id when reporting quota anomalies. makes triage faster.

eli_r: done, pushed. merging after CI passes. :thumbsup:
